data.name: Nabahat
data.gender_notes: Nabahat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nabahat is an Arabic name that signifies elegance, refinement, and sophistication. It is a name that evokes a sense of beauty and poise, making it a popular choice for parents looking for a name that exudes grace and charm. The name Nabahat carries the meaning “Elegance and Refinement” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabahat usually hope their child will grow to embody elegance and refinement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nabahat is associated with the concept of ihsan, or excellence, which is considered a fundamental virtue in the Quran.
data.etymology: Nabahat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegance and Refinement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabahat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نَبَاحَة

in_arabic.long_meaning: تأتي نَبَاحَة من الجذر النبأ والذي يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في الألفاظ: نَبَأَ، نَبَأتُ، نَبَأتَهُ، نَبَأتُها، نَبَأتُهم. في هذا الاسم، يُشير إلى الراحة والتجديد، حيث يُستخدم في الأصل للإشارة إلى الخبر الجيد أو النبأ، ويُشير إلى المكان الذي يوجد فيه الخير والراحة

in_urdu.name: نباہت

data.cultural_impact: Nabahat is a name that has its roots deeply embedded in Islamic culture. It originated from the Arabic word "nabaha" which means "to raise" or "to exalt". Historically, this name was often given to children born into noble or ruling families, as it symbolized their elevated status and refined upbringing. The elegance and sophistication denoted by the name Nabahat have been consistently celebrated in Islamic literature, art, and music, making it a name that continues to resonate with the cultural values and aesthetics of the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: Nabahat is also a name that holds significant spiritual meaning in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes the idea of spiritual growth and development. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once spoke of the importance of continuous spiritual refinement, saying, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his good deeds." (Bukhari). By giving their child the name Nabahat, parents may be encouraging them to strive for spiritual growth and refinement throughout their lives, helping them to build a strong and lasting connection with God.
